scientific_integrity: Analytical proof; packaged exact-integer finite tests are corroboration only. Prior coverage compared at hypothesis-and-implication level; independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem covers additive positive personalized two-tier singleton values, n agents, at most n+1 goods arriving one at a time; it does not establish EF1 beyond the first surplus or welfare efficiency.
title: One-surplus temporal EF1 for personalized positive two-tier goods
